zh: 常作「難遭難遇」想，要把握當下的機遇，時時是好日，處處是好地。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Opportunity seldom knocks twice; seize the moment. Every day is a good day, every place is a good place.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 錢財是五家共有的，健康、名譽、福德、人緣、善事才是自己擁有的。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Monetary wealth is never truly yours. At the end of the day, it is your health, honor, blessings, personality, and kind deeds that are truly yours.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 做人要做得心甘情願，並且要能不忘初心，有容乃大。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Be perfectly willing in all your endeavors; never forget your initial resolve; a magnanimous mind bears greatness.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 在世間上，「擁有」是一種負擔，如果建立「享有」的觀念，則可有可無也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: In this world, possession can be a burden. Once a mindset of “appreciation of what we have” is developed, it will no longer matter whether we have or not.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不比較，不計較，不怕難，不怕苦，成功、福樂全在其中。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Never compare, never fuss, never fear adversity, and never fear suffering, for these are the foundations of success, fortune, and happiness.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 忙，就是營養，要忙得給人歡喜、忙得給人接受，要忙得讓人我和諧。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Find nourishment in being busy. Get busy with giving others joy, get busy with gaining acceptance from others, and get busy with keeping in harmony with others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 聖人也會給人批評，要把批評、毀謗、委屈當為營養。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Even sages are criticized; regard criticism, slander and aggrievement as a nutrient for life.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 因緣能成就一切，要給人一些因緣，唯有給人因緣，才是最大功德。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: All things are created by causes and conditions; make it a point to give others causes and conditions, because only the greatest merit arises from doing so.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 世間事有苦有樂，這是當然的，所謂「吃得苦中苦，方為人上人」。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: All the joys and sufferings of this world occur as a matter of course; just as the saying goes, “Through hardship to the stars.”
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 小，不能忽視，涓涓細流可以成為大海汪洋；小小兒童將來成為國家棟樑，所謂「滴水之恩」，不可不報也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Small things should not be overlooked; even the smallest stream may one day turn into a grand ocean, and toddlers will one day become the future of our nation. Even kindness in the smallest form of a waterdrop must be repaid.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 你重要，他重要，我不重要，因為犧牲、奉獻、吃虧，才是真正的福報。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: You are important and he is important; I am not important, because it is a true blessing to be able to sacrifice, to give, and to be at a disadvantage.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 重新估定價值，正知正見可以裁定人我關係，凡事不要那麼執著。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Constantly re-evaluate your values; right view and right thought can help you make right decisions on relationships. There is no need to be overly attached to everything.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 你大我小，你對我錯，你樂我苦，你有我無，這個可以顛覆自己、昇華自己，奧妙無窮。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: You are important and I am not. You are right, and I am wrong. You enjoy happiness, while I take on suffering. You can have, while I keep nothing. This mindset can be a tremendously wondrous revolution for self-reform and self-improvement.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 仁義是中華文的中心，要做仁者、義工，因為這是救苦救難的菩薩準則。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Benevolence and righteousness are the core of Chinese culture. It is important to be benevolent and to volunteer, because these are the principle of a bodhisattva who relieves the suffering and hardship of others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不知道有不知道的樂趣，世間上的事，不必全部知道；不聽不聞，也可以把它當作一種享受。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Sometimes there is joy in not knowing; there is no need to know everything in this world, as it can also be an enjoyment to not hear or listen to certain matters.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 從善如流，予人方便，要結緣，不要結怨。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Forge ahead in doing what is right; it should be our goal to give others convenience and to develop affinity instead of enmity.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要知道慚愧、反省、自責，因為這樣才會更進步。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: It is important to have a sense of shame, introspection, and remorse, for these make us better people.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要隨人情起舞，人情的喜惡變化無窮，對與不對，要自己決定。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not get wrapped up in personal favors, for human emotions are impermanent and may change any time. It is up to ourselves to determine what is right and what is not.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要利用零碎時間，時間才是我們的財富和生命；把零碎的時間結合起來，就是一個完整的人生。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Utilize spare times effectively, because time is wealth, time is life. Life is made whole when we are able to make every second count.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要能皆大歡喜，不要給人難堪，要給人祝福、給人服務、給人利行，才是做人之道。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: A happy outcome for all is best. Do not humiliate others; proper human conduct is displayed in giving others our blessings, our services, and our support.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要有佛法就有辦法，什麼是佛法？忍耐、慈悲、無執、智慧、親和、尊重都是佛法也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Dharma will find a way. What is Dharma? Patience, compassion, detachment, wisdom, friendliness, and respect are all forms of Dharma.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 生氣不能解決問題，要能爭氣才更重要。生的氣，是自我膨脹，熄下不平之氣，所謂心平氣和是也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Anger does not solve problems; working hard to resolve a situation does. Anger is a result of an inflated ego whose fury, once extinguished, will transform into a mind of peace and calmness.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 破銅爛鐵也能成鋼，對自己要有信心；你不是破銅爛鐵，你自己可以做黃金、白玉，但黃金仍需洪爐煉，白玉還要妙手磨。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Have confidence in yourself, for even scrap metal can be turned into steel; though the choice of becoming gold or jade lies in your own hands, gold must still first withstand the furnace of refinement, and jade the skillful hands of craftsmanship.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 做什麼要像什麼，把人做好才是重要；要獲得別人普遍的稱讚，才是好人也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Play your role well, nothing is more important than living your life well. A good person is one who is praised by people in general.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 承擔「自己是佛」，嫉妒是佛嗎？怨恨是佛嗎？貪欲是佛嗎？不講理是佛嗎？可以自問自討？
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Tell yourself that “I am a Buddha.” Does Buddha have jealousy? Does Buddha have hatred? Would Buddha be unreasonable?
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 珍惜善美的因緣，不要錯失良機。好因緣也是一時的，不擅於把握，鴻雁也要飛走啊！
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Good causes and conditions are hard to come by, do not let a good opportunity pass you by. Even a favorable condition only exists in the moment; if neglected, it will fly away like a golden goose.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 給人利用才有價值，吃虧、服務才會更有成就。對方八兩，你何必半斤？你應該做重如千斤之人哦！
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Being used by others gives us value. Those who are at a disadvantage and willingly help others are the real winners.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要貪瞋、不要無明，因為無明就像不講理的人。無明人就不像個人了。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not be greedy, or ignorant; being ignorant is the same as being unreasonable, which would be inhumane.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 在世間上什麼都是我的，什麼都不是我的。來了，要好好珍惜；去了，那也是別人的因緣，甚至也有再來的機會。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: In this world, everything is mine, yet nothing is mine. Cherish what comes to us, and wish others well with what comes to them; opportunity could even come another day.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要做好人，諸惡莫作，眾善奉行。十惡是：身犯殺、盜、邪淫，口說妄語、謊言、惡口、搬弄是非等不正當的話，心中有貪欲、瞋恨、愚痴也。反之，則為十種善事了。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Be a good person, do no evil, and do good deeds. The Ten Unwholesome Deeds refer to: physical deeds of killing, stealing, and sexual misconduct; verbal deeds of false speech, malicious speech, harsh speech, and gossip; mental deeds of greed, aversion, and ignorance. Contrary actions would become the Ten Wholesome Deeds.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 人我之間要像跳探戈，該進則進，該退則退。讓人討些便宜，自己不算吃虧。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Relationships are like dancing Tango: sometimes you lead and sometimes you follow. It is not a total loss when others to take advantage of you.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 結緣總比結怨好，要實踐三好、四給、五和。三好是做好事、說好話、存好心；四給即給人信心、給人歡喜、給人希望、給人方便；五和是：自心和悅、家庭和順、人我和敬、社會和諧、世界和平。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: It is better to develop affinities than make enemies. Practice the Three Acts of Goodness: do good deeds, speak good words, and think good thoughts; the Four Givings: give others faith, give others joy, give others hope, and give others convenience; and the Five Harmonies: individual harmony achieved through joy, family harmony achieved through deference, interpersonal harmony achieved through respect, social harmony achieved through cooperation, and world harmony achieved through peace.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 拒絕別人不要太過無情，要婉轉，要有一些代替的鼓勵；能幹的人，方法總是多的啊！
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Refusal should be made with sympathy, subtlety, and the presentation of an alternative; competent people are always able to find many solutions.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 天堂地獄都在一念之間，每個人每天都要上天多次，也可能在地獄來往；好心好事，必定上天堂也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Heaven and hell are all in a moment of thought; each one of us could go back and forth between heaven and hell many times a day.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 虛空之大，能容萬物，房舍、皮箱、碗盤器皿等都要有空間，才能擁有物品哦！
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: The vast emptiness can embody everything, just as a house, a suitcase, and food utensils need to be empty to contain anything.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 自我要把持正派的、善美的、淨化的心念，因為求人不如求己也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: We must discipline ourselves to remain righteous, virtuous, and pure in thought, because ultimately we can only rely on ourselves, not others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 未來一定比現在更好，應該要加倍努力；有希望，就有力量。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Hope is strength; the future will definitely be better than now, so work extra hard.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 有理想才能實踐，要有願力才能完成理想。所謂有未來，都因為有立志也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Before any ideal is realized, you must first have aspiration, with which a promising future then becomes within reach.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 永不退票，信守承諾；你要人家怎樣對你，你先怎樣待人。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Never go back on your word, keep your promises. Treat others as you wish to be treated.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 健康、平安、緣分、歡喜，都比金錢重要；錢財是大家的，修養、胸量才是自己的。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Good health, safety, affinities, and joy are more important than money. Money is never truly yours, only forbearance and a big heart.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 能捨，必有得，有播種，才會有收成；莫以善小而不為，莫以惡小而為之，小，終能成大也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: You must give before you gain; you must sow before you reap. Do not overlook any chance to do a minor good deed, nor indulge in any minor bad deed, because anything minor will eventually turn into something major.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 我們都在寫歷史，要立功、立德、立言；在你的人生紀錄上，是什麼歷史呢？
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: We are all creating history, therefore we must establish ourselves in merit, in virtue, and in speech. What kind of history would you like to leave behind in life?
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 面對問題，不要退縮，心存善念，光明在前。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Don’t run away from your problems; when your mind is filled with goodness, a bright future lies ahead.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要活得自由自在，心無罣礙，無有恐怖，遠離顛倒夢想。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Live a carefree life; let the mind be free of troubles, empty of fear, and far from inverted thoughts of delusion.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不能不信因果，因緣果報是宇宙的真理法則。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: You must believe in cause and effect, for the rule of cause, condition, and effect is the Truth of the universe.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 做人必定要有志願，願心的昇華，聞思修三慧有重大的幫助。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Resolve is an essential part of life, which can be strengthened by listening, contemplating, and practicing the Dharma.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 千載一時，一時千載，要好好把握機會；好多的因緣好事就在當下，不要輕易放過。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Opportunities arise in rare moments in time; seize the moment. Good causes and good conditions all exist in the here and now, do not easily miss them.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 愛，就是惜，就是慈悲、服務、包容、智慧、尊重，愛人的人不跟人對立。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: To love means to cherish, to be compassionate, to be of service, to be tolerant, to be wise, and to be respectful. One who loves others will not oppose them.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 排難解紛不是閒事，幫忙就有功德。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Reconciliation is not a trivial matter; it has the potential to give rise to merit.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 有情有義，情義是人生的基石；有時候，用情義可以化解一些困難的問題。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Sentiment and righteousness are the cornerstones of life; sometimes they can be the key to solving problems.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 生活要淡泊，奢華是浪費；勤儉才是生活的要道。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Live a simple life, because extravagance is a waste; only frugality is the way to live.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 滿樹桃花一棵根，因緣果報重重無盡，珍惜因緣善念，必有好運。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Just as a tree full of plum blossoms all trace back to the same root, the relationship between causes, conditions, and effects is endless. By cherishing your blessings and being kind, you will certainly have good luck.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 從新做起，從今做起，從己做起；不推諉，不拖延，不依賴。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Start anew, start with today, and start with yourself. Do not shirk responsibilities, do not procrastinate, and do not rely on others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 忍耐就是力量，就是智慧，就是心量。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Patience is power, patience is wisdom, and patience is magnanimity.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要向別人革命，要向自己革命，革除私心、陋習，前途光明。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Instead of challenging others, challenge yourself by overthrowing your selfishness and bad habits, and a bright future lies ahead.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要將歡喜布滿人間，要把自己活在歡喜中。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Spread happiness around the world, and live in happiness.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要有向困難挑戰的勇氣，只要有心人，世間無難事也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Be brave enough to face hardships and challenges. Nothing is difficult in the face of determination.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 好事從我做起，好話從我說起，好心從我生起。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Be the one to start doing good deeds, be the one to start speaking good words, and be the one to start thinking good thoughts.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 做自己的貴人，自己有力量，才能解決問題。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Be your own mentor. Only when you are strong will problems be solved.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 幸福，就在當下；幸福，要感受，要珍惜。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Happiness is in the here and now. Experience your happiness, and think well of it.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 人要有信仰，尤其要對自己有信心，有信心的人，才自覺幸福。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: We must have faith, especially faith in ourselves; only those who have faith in themselves will feel happy and fortunate.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 做人要有道德正義的立場，能不為情動，不為利動，不要為權勢威武所動。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: We must maintain a stance of moral righteousness and justice. Do not be moved by money, do not be moved by emotions, and do not be moved by circumstances.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 凡事思前想後，要提起正念，不要太多疑慮。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Consider past causes and future effects for all matters you encounter; uphold right mindfulness; do not be overly sentimental.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要做正人君子，人我是非不要計較。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Be a person of moral integrity; do not fuss over disputes of right and wrong.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 保持歡喜，因為你可以自己決定一切。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Stay joyful, because you can be the one to make the decision.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 成功不是夢想，只要自己誠信、篤實、勤勞、奮發有為；受冤枉、受委屈，不要生氣。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Success is not a dream as long as you are honest, sincere, diligent, inspired, and hardworking; do not respond to injustice and aggrievement with anger.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 提得起，放得下，要能提放自如。好比皮箱，用之提起，不用時放下。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Picking up and letting go; one must learn to do both with ease. It is just like a suitcase -- pick it up when you need it, and put it down when you don’t.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要給人接受，禮貌、勤勞、負責、服務不能少。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: To gain acceptance by others, one’s manners, diligence, responsibility, and service should not be amiss.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 我在眾中，因為我的一切與大眾都有關係。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: As a member of the community, I realize that it plays a part in everything that I have become.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 當笑要笑，當說要說，當做要做，把握機緣。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Laugh when it is time to laugh, speak when it is time to speak, and act when it is time to act.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 隨緣、隨分、隨心、隨眾，你都能隨順自在嗎？
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Follow conditions, follow your role, follow your heart, and follow your community. Are you able to follow and oblige all sentient beings?
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 服務奉獻中成就他人，努力工作中實現自我。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Help others succeed through your service and dedication. Realize the self through diligence and hard work.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 多聽別人的批評，認錯是美德，不是什麼不好的事。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Humble acceptance of criticism and admitting one’s faults is a virtue; nothing bad will come out of doing so.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 至道無難，唯嫌揀擇，不要多疑執著；所謂真理遍滿虛空，充塞法界。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Attainment is not difficult; the only obstacle that exists is being picky; the Truth is omnipresent and ubiquitous.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 人要活在希望之中，在生活裡有無限的喜悅，為什麼要去煩惱罣礙呢。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Live within hope; there is boundless joy in life, so why spend time worrying?
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 立定腳跟做好人，存好心，起善念，風霜雨雪不足畏也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Stand firm and be a good person, think good thoughts, and be kind; storms and harsh weather will not be sufficient to arouse fear.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 事情可以做完，恭敬心不可缺少；話不要說盡，因為語言會給人誤解。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Though we can complete a task, we must not fall short of respect for others; never speak with full intent, because language can cause misunderstandings.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 待人好，是重要的，要讓人感覺到你是他的有緣人，更為重要。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: It is important to be kind to others; it is even more important to let others feel affinity with you.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 待人不要太過小氣，與人結緣，才會更有人緣。所謂能捨，才能得也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not be too stingy. The willingness to develop affinities will broaden your connections. No giving, no gain.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 布施不一定用金錢，微笑、禮貌、讚嘆、服務、給人好因好緣，都是布施也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Giving is not always done with money. A smile, words of compliment, acts of service, and offering good causes and conditions to others are also forms of giving.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 勤有功，戲無益，要檢查自己的功過，才能做人上人也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: There is merit in diligence and no benefit in play. In order to become the best of the best, we must first examine our merits and faults.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 滿手好事，滿口好話，滿面微笑，滿心歡喜。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do a handful of good deeds, speak a mouthful good words, show a face full of smile; and have a heart full of joy.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 成就好事，要有恆心毅力；要做好人，就要耐怨耐忍；不要生氣，生氣可能壞諸好事。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: The accomplishment of good things requires persistence and willpower.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 捨去一步，才能向前；給人利用，方能成功；你要覺得別人比自己重要。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Only by relinquishing your previous step can you make the next one forward. Success comes from allowing others to take advantage of your abilities; always place others before you.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要錯怪別人，對人要寬厚，對己要嚴厲，所謂「寬以待人，嚴以責己」。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not wrong others, treat others with tolerance, but treat yourself with strict discipline. Be strict with oneself and lenient towards others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 什麼都可以缺少，慈悲喜捨不可少也；善事好心都可增加，貪瞋氣惱不可增也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: You can be short of anything, as long as it is not loving-kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity. Increase only good deeds and kind intentions, never greed, aversion, or anger.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 人我是非不要放在心上，怨恨惱亂不可留到明天。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not take the stresses generated by gossip to heart, and never bring your troubles and resentments to the next day.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 冤枉、委屈，不要計較，路遙知馬力，日久見人心。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Rise above the occasion; do not let the feelings of injustice or being wronged bother you; time will do justice by revealing a person’s true heart.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 面對世間事，可以用歡喜微笑化解怨恨和對立；用歡喜微笑，世間沒有解決不了的事情。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Any animosity that exists in this world can be resolved with joy and smiles, with which nothing in the world is unresolveable.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要悲傷沮喪，要勇敢面對現實；智仁勇三達德，可助成好事也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Instead of being sad and depressed, face reality with courage. The Three Primary Virtues -- wisdom, benevolence, and courage can help achieve great things.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 能承擔世間憂悲苦惱，樂於幫助服務別人，才是人間菩薩。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: A Humanistic Bodhisattva is one who can shoulder the world’s sadness, sorrow, suffering, and troubles, and is always willing to help others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 掌握時間，善用空間，和諧人我之間。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Take control of your time, make good use of your space, and harmonize the human world.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要從工作中找到歡喜和快樂，要從讀書中，找到智慧和悟道。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Discover joy and happiness in your work and life; find wisdom and enlightenment in books.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 心量有多大，成就就有多大；心量小的人，老是和人計較，難成大事。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: The bigger your heart, the greater your achievements; the narrow-minded who always fusses over matters will not achieve great things.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 敬人者，人恆敬之，佛法就是在恭敬中求；你要用人，就要信而不疑。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: One who respects others will be respected; Dharma is sought within respect. Trust the people who work for you and never doubt them.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 凡事不要譴責別人，能體諒、包容最好；譴責別人，先想想自己的條件如何。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not reproach others; tolerance and magnanimity is the best. First assess your own abilities before you even reproach others.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要緊張，放鬆自己，只要合情合理，沒有解決不了的問題。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Don’t be nervous. Relax. Just as long as there is sense and reason, there is no problem that cannot be resolved.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 要修習讚歎法門，讚歎別人，給人歡喜，妙用無窮。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Practice the act of giving praise, compliments, and joy to others, for its benefits are inexhaustible.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 智仁勇三達德，智，般若也，仁，慈悲也，勇，菩提也，這裡面佛法、世法都已經俱全了。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: The Three Primary Virtues consist of wisdom, benevolence, and courage. Wisdom is prajna, benevolence is loving-kindness and compassion, and courage is bodhi; Dharma and worldly knowledge are all present within.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 三好運動即身做好事、口說好話、心存好念；說好話即是真，做好事即是善，存好心即是美，做到真善美，是聖賢人也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: The Three Acts of Goodness are: do good deeds, speak good words, and think good thoughts. The first represents truthfulness, while the second virtue, and the third beauty; the ability to accomplish all three makes one eminent and respectable.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 喜悅的人，應將憂鬱煩惱拋向海洋裡去；不要把憂鬱煩惱帶到床上，更不要把憂鬱煩惱留到明天。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: A joyful mind throws all troubles and worries into the ocean; never bring your worries to bed, and never take your worries to the next day.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 愛心的昇華就是慈悲，慈悲沒有敵人，更不會跟人對立；人我不對立，自然沒有煩惱。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Love, when sublimated, becomes compassion, which sees no enemies nor oppositions; when opposition is absent, troubles will naturally be absent too.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要住在色聲香味觸法裡，要住在慈悲喜捨六度萬行之中。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not abide in form, sound, smell, taste, touch, or dharma. Abide in kindness, compassion, joy, and equanimity; abide in the Six Perfections.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 不要遷怒別人，不二過是正人君子的本分；文過飾非的人，就是沒有人計較，還是不健全的人。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not take your anger out on others; a superior man is one who never repeats the same mistakes. One who covers up his mistakes, even if not reprimanded by others, is still considered unwholesome.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 苦難要能承擔，因為吃苦是教育，能讓我們增上；面對困難克服他，才能成進，才能進步。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Accept hardships and adversity, for it is a lesson that makes us better; by facing and overcoming hardships, we are then able to improve.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 對朋友能不念舊惡，所謂友直、友諒、友多聞；朋友有四品，有友如華，有友如稱，有友如山，有友如地。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Do not hold grudges against your friends. Friends are direct, friends forgive, and friends listen. There are four type of friends: ones who are like flowers, ones who are like scales, ones who are like mountains, and ones who are like the Earth.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 人我之間，熱戰固然不好，冷戰也是不當；互助、互諒、互信、互解，才是朋友之道也。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: Within a relationship, while heated battles are not good, cold wars are also inappropriate. Friends help, forgive, trust, and understand each other.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life

zh: 想成功，要有通路，事通、理通、人我都通。
zhSrc: 星雲大師法語 - 人生卜事
en: In order to succeed, the path must be clear, matters must be clear, reason must be clear, and communication between people must be clear.
enSrc: Dharma Words from Venerable Master Hsing Yun - Positive Forecasts for Life
